dogs.name: Rome
dogs.intro: Smart, social, and incredibly cuddly, Rome is a sweet little leader with a personality that's impossible not to love. 🤍
dogs.fosterNote:
Rome is a quiet little leader with such an engaging and lovable personality. He's social, active, sweet, and incredibly smart, but he also has the cuddliest side and loves being close to his people.

With his adorable Rottweiler-like coloring, Rome looks almost identical to his sibling Amalfi, although Rome has a little more light brown around his eyelids. His foster says he's definitely in the running as one of their favorites! 🥹
dogs.rescueStory: Rome is safe in our care and getting lots of love while he waits for his forever home.
dogs.idealHome: Rome would thrive with a loving family ready to give him plenty of playtime, continued training, socialization, and cuddles as he grows. With his smart, sweet personality, he's sure to make an amazing addition to his forever family. ❤️

dogs.name: Cosmides
dogs.intro: Please meet Cosmides! This sweet and playful little pup is ready to curl up with her furever family!
dogs.fosterNote: Cosmides is a precious and calm little pup who loves a good cuddle and will snuggle through a good movie with you. When she's not snuggling her people, she is outside exploring. Cosmides loves playing with her foster family's pup, a German Shepherd, and the two are already best pals! She's the perfect combination of sweet and snuggly with a fun, adventurous spirit. Cosmides would thrive with a family who shares her love of exploring and adventure, but who is always ready to come home, curl up on the couch, and enjoy some good snuggles. She's a special little pup who is ready to find her forever family!
dogs.rescueStory: Cosmides was rescued from Bakersfield Shelter!
dogs.idealHome: Cosmides would do well in a home that allows her to explore to her hearts desire and snuggle up as long as she wants!

dogs.name: Mr. Lemon
dogs.intro: Me. Lemon is a playful and loving little pup who will add so much light and laughter into a home!
dogs.fosterNote: Mr Lemons is very energetic and active youngster. A regal, active gentleman who loves to play. His favorite activity right now is chasing around his sibling!
dogs.rescueStory: Mr.Lemon was rescued from Kerman Animal Shelter!
dogs.idealHome: Mr.Lemon would do well in an active and playful household that is ready to take on his adorable puppy energy!

dogs.name: Biscuit
dogs.intro: This distinguished gentleman is looking for a cozy place to spend his golden years! 👴🏼
dogs.fosterNote: Biscuit is the easiest dog I have ever fostered. He loves slow walks, belly rubs, and a soft bed by the window. He is fully house trained and sleeps through the night.
dogs.rescueStory: Biscuit was surrendered to a crowded shelter after his owner passed away.
dogs.idealHome: A calm home with someone who wants a loyal couch buddy.

dogs.name: Juniper
dogs.intro: Juniper is a goofy, talkative girl who needs a foster or forever home ASAP!
dogs.rescueStory: Juniper was pulled from the Baldwin Park shelter on her last day.
dogs.idealHome: An active home with a secure yard and someone who loves hikes!

dogs.name: Pepper
dogs.intro: Pepper has the biggest smile in LA and a heart to match! 💕
dogs.fosterNote: Pepper knows sit, down, and paw, rides beautifully in the car, and has never met a person she didn't love. She would prefer to be the only dog.
dogs.idealHome: A dog-free home with people who love snuggles and adventures.
